selected_script.angle: Reorganizing a cramped microwave seasoning setup by utilizing the side of the microwave/fridge with heavy-duty matte black magnetic racks
selected_script.hook: Stop cramming your seasoning bottles into overstuffed cabinets where you can't see them.

segment_01.voiceover: Stop cramming seasoning bottles into overstuffed cabinets. Put them right on the side of your microwave with these magnetic racks. They snap on instantly!
segment_01.camera_action: Start with close-up of cluttered cabinet, quick cut to hands placing a matte black metal magnetic rack on the side of a microwave.

segment_02.voiceover: They are made of heavy-duty rustproof carbon steel and support up to eleven pounds. Look how stable they stay even with heavy spice jars!
segment_02.camera_action: Show hand loading several large glass spice bottles onto the rack, demonstrating stability and zero slipping.

segment_03.voiceover: Plus, these detachable hooks are perfect for keeping oven mitts and utensils right where you need them. Reclaim your kitchen space today!
segment_03.camera_action: Zoom in on the bottom edge where metal hooks hang, showing a hand hanging a kitchen glove, panning out to show a clean kitchen scene.

broll_coverage.camera_action: Detailed B-roll sequence showing the high flat back plate attaching to the side of a fridge, detailing the matte black metal texture and bottom hooks.
